source.go_outbound_request_test: conduit/llm/transformer/openai/image_inbound_test.go::TestImageInboundTransformer_TransformRequest_Generation_JSON (outbound leg, L54-64); routing/metadata assertions from image_outbound_test.go::TestBuildImageGenerationAPIRequest_RoutesToGenerate (L321-338) and TestBuildImageGenerateRequest_BasicPrompt (L90-121, same builder path)
source.note: Request-only case for POST /v1/images/generations (JSON body). A single Go test drives the full inbound->outbound request chain with one coherent fixture (dall-e-3, prompt 'a cat', n=2, response_format 'url', size '1024x1024', user 'u1'). selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null because the unit test does not exercise those stages.

inbound_http._comment: Verbatim reqBody literal from the Go test (L23-30), wrapped in httpclient.Request{Method POST, URL http://localhost/v1/images/generations, Content-Type application/json}.

unified_request._comment: Expected llm.Request from ImageInboundTransformer(generation).TransformRequest. Byte-asserted (L42-52): RequestType==image, APIFormat==openai/image_generation, Model=='dall-e-3', Modalities contains 'image', *Stream==false, Image.Prompt=='a cat', *Image.N==2, Image.ResponseFormat=='url', Image.Size=='1024x1024'. image.user=='u1' is copied by transformGenerationRequest (image_inbound.go L230-247) but not directly asserted.

outbound_http._comment: OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest output. Byte-asserted in this test: URL=='https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations', body contains '"response_format":"url"' and '"n":2'. Method POST, Content-Type/Accept headers and bearer auth come from buildImageGenerateRequest (image_outbound.go; Method/Content-Type also asserted by TestBuildImageGenerateRequest_BasicPrompt). request api_format and transformer_metadata.model asserted by TestBuildImageGenerationAPIRequest_RoutesToGenerate. PARITY GOTCHA: buildImageGenerateRequest builds the outbound body from an allowlist map and does NOT forward 'user' — the inbound 'user':'u1' is dropped from the outbound wire body.
